Disclosed open economic findings and security-review scope

blacklistabilityReview.evidence: ComplianceRegistry sanctions/jurisdiction blocks are checked on every USDfr transfer and prevent blocked senders and recipients from minting or redeeming. Primary KYC gates are separate from this holder blocklist. Underlying USDC adds freeze exposure. The security page separately discloses external-wrapper composability limitations, not a token blacklist absence.

oracleRisk.summary: ReserveManager accounting uses loan principal/accrual and collateral facts authorized by the threshold-signed AttestationOracle. Governance controls attester roles, threshold and professional impairment assessments; actual current attester quorum and independent offchain valuation are unverified. These top-level marks affect backing and redemption, not a public independent NAV feed.

branchApplicability.rationale: USDfr is a senior protocol dollar claim, using loan-book reserve and attested impairment marks in issuance/exit. The curated review covers this top-level price authority without inventing a CDP collateral-market branch set.
